title: FFYPVP
description: The Bed Wars texture pack includes: low fire, short swords, sky (OptiFine), wool, minerals, items (blaze powder, blaze rods, ender pearls...), and food (golden apples [enchanted]).
body:
# The Bed Wars texture pack 
## includes: 
- **low fire**
- **short swords**
- **sky (OptiFine，Looks cool)**
- **wool(Classic), minerals（Eye-Health Boost Pills）**
- **items (blaze powder（Cool dynamic material）**
- **blaze rods**
- **ender pearls（has Cool dynamic material too）...)**
- **food (golden apples [enchanted]).**

## The sky and box UI have a bit of a bug, should be fixed soon.
